notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Smith Ferry is not registered in the cached National Historic Lookout Register or FFLOS listings for Texas, and no construction date, design, height, staffing, or fate (standing/removed/burned) beyond the FFLA list's bare 'Standing' turned up in two web searches plus the cached regional lookout lists. The Texas Escapes citation is general East Texas context (phase-out to aerial patrol), not Smith-Ferry-specific; flagged as such in the story. Worth a follow-up with Texas A&M Forest Service records or Tyler County historical sources if a human researcher has more time/budget.
